scope: Retained old binary current-protocol S3 before/after baseline: three steady samples per workload, full prelude and600s soak. NOT four-hour endurance, final-candidate approval or production/cloud capacity certification.

profile.arrival_counter_protocol: continuous sparse scheduler counters; 120s lookback; maximum 30s polling gap; bounded phase state
profile.http_counter_protocol: continuous per-series HTTP and expected-rejection counters; 120s lookback; maximum 30s polling gap; bounded phase state
profile.successful_latency_protocol: monotonic logical request including DNS, connections, redirects and final response
profile.generator_observation_protocol: owned Docker stats with verified cgroup-v2 fallback on 10s stream timeout; unchanged 30s observation gate
profile.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
profile.resource_protocol: component cgroup v2, PostgreSQL IO/WAL/checkpointer/locks, process owners; allocated du totals count only disappearing child entries
profile.webhook_history_maintenance: explicit admin clear at 5000 terminal records; committed identities retained by fixture audit trigger

session_canary.scope: 600s baseline has no long-session renewal canary; no observed zero or endurance approval is inferred

resources.ownership_scope: Observed OS owner censuses are listed for each pressure/rest plateau and final idle; their equality is reported explicitly rather than assumed. RSS/anonymous retention alone does not establish allocation ownership or absolute absence of a leak. PostgreSQL memory includes reclaimable cache; kernel memory.peak may transiently exceed memory.max by a charge batch.
resources.task_scope: Observed OS threads/tasks; not an exact count of Tokio futures or live heap objects.

fixture_census.scope: Read-only post-load census for an owned single-project fixture. Counts are taken after measured traffic, with a fresh read-only connection; preparation/load durations and performance samples are unchanged. This does not certify every integrity or ownership gate.

baseline_candidate_regression: not yet established; requires final independent comparable run
